text_run.content: A stage is an intermediate storage spot where you can hold your data for further processing, such as data merging<include target="saas">, migration,</include> or importing.
This page explains how you can use
For details about managing volumes via web console, see
You can only create volumes on AWS and Google Cloud. If you need to use a volume on Azure, please
To import, merge, or migrate data from a volume to a cluster, ensure that the volume and the cluster are within the same cloud region.

When using a Zilliz Cloud stage, you upload data from an applicable external source, such as local files and third-party object storage to create files in the stage for further processing. The following diagram shows the major application scenarios of Zilliz Cloud stages.
You can use stages in data import<include target="saas">, data migration,</include> and data merging, all of which need to fetch data from external sources but use the fetched data in different ways.
During data import, you can upload prepared datasets into a stage and import them from the stage into a Zilliz Cloud collection. For details, refer to
You can merge data from an existing Zilliz Cloud collection and that from a local file uploaded to a stage to create a collection that combines the data from both sources. For details, refer to
In data migration, you upload backup files of your Milvus instance into a stage and use the staged data to restore the Milvus instance as a Zilliz Cloud cluster. For details, refer to
